editorial:
You play Will Shaw, a young Wall Street trader who just wants a relaxing sailing trip in Spain with his family. But when they vanish without a trace, your vacation turns into a nightmare. Suddenly, you're pulled into a world of spies, secrets, and double-crosses, learning that your own father has been hiding a dangerous life as an intelligence agent. The movie throws you into the action fast, with sun-soaked Spanish streets turning into deadly chase scenes. Henry Cavill carries the film well as an ordinary guy forced to become a hero overnight, while Bruce Willis and Sigourney Weaver add star power as the mysterious figures pulling the strings. The vibe is tense and urgent, like a classic spy thriller mixed with a family rescue story.

The action keeps moving, with car chases and shootouts that feel grounded rather than over-the-top. The pacing rarely slows down, which keeps you hooked even when the plot gets a little messy. On the downside, some twists feel predictable, and the story doesn't always make perfect sense. Still, if you enjoy fast, no-nonsense thrillers with a European backdrop, this one delivers. It's a solid pick for a weekend movie night. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Will discovers the briefcase everyone wants contains important intelligence files. His father is killed, and Will realizes his dad's partner, Jean Carrack, has been working against them the whole time. Will teams up with a Spanish agent to track down Carrack. In the climax, Will confronts her on a rooftop, and she falls to her death after a struggle. Will rescues his surviving family members and hands the briefcase over to the right people, finally clearing his father's name and ending the nightmare.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves fast spy thrillers with a European setting.
